name: Agnostics
overview: Scripture reveals that salvation and eternal life come only through faith in Jesus Christ, as God has provided His Son for the world’s redemption (John 3:16, 3:36). No one can come to Christ apart from the Father’s drawing (John 6:44), and true discipleship is marked by continuing in Jesus’ word (John 8:31). The Bible also teaches that faith arises through hearing the Word of God (Romans 10:17), while God's righteous wrath is revealed against those who suppress the truth in unrighteousness (Romans 1:18). This underscores the necessity of responding to God’s revelation rather than remaining uncertain or indifferent about His existence and salvation.
